subject.title: chore(env): config-surface reduction tranche 4 — env-var cleanup (review request)

question: Should OpenClaw retire the identified undocumented `OPENCLAW_*` aliases immediately as internal implementation details, or preserve any of them through a named deprecation path?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes environment behaviors that may exist in user scripts or external wrappers but cannot be migrated by `openclaw doctor --fix`; repository policy treats config and environment compatibility as upgrade-sensitive.

options.title: Approve documented-only contract
options.body: Approve immediate retirement of the listed undocumented aliases and keep `docs/help/environment.md` as the sole operator-facing environment contract.

options.title: Deprecate selected aliases
options.body: Keep specifically identified externally used aliases temporarily with warning or migration guidance before removing them in a later release.

recommendation.title: Approve documented-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve immediate retirement of the listed undocumented aliases and keep `docs/help/environment.md` as the sole operator-facing environment contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the related merged config-surface reductions and authored the current environment-contract proposal.
